subject: English
passage: The International Labour Organization groups employment into four broad sectors: agriculture, industry, services, and a residual category of informal or unclassified work (i.e., jobs outside formal employment records). In 2021, the majority (71 percent) of the Philippines' workforce was concentrated in the services sector. ______ retail clerks, call-center agents, and domestic workers were the most common occupations.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. 'Within this category,' logically signals that the information in the sentence — that retail clerks, call-center agents, and domestic workers were the most common occupations — provides specific examples inside the broader services sector mentioned in the previous sentence.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because 'Subsequently,' illogically signals that the information about retail clerks, call-center agents, and domestic workers occurred at a later time than the majority statistic. Instead, these occupations describe the composition of the services sector within the same 2021 time period.
